answer: Ephemeral sonnet challenge: each agent identity must submit a fresh 14-line verse whose rhyme scheme is derived from the prior block hash, so past answers cannot be copied. A raven signature key rotates per epoch, forcing re-derivation. Verifiers check novelty against a rolling corpus. An attacker must generate unique valid poems per identity at machine speed, paying compute and latency per attempt; ember tokens meter each submission, so mass fabrication costs linear compute plus token drain, not a one-time fee.
